subject.title: WhatsApp group messages never reach inbound handling (LID groups?) — DMs work; repro across relink + 2026.6.11→2026.7.1

question: Should the WhatsApp plugin adopt a Desktop browser identity by default and guide existing custom-identity sessions through re-pairing, or retain the current identity while pursuing a different upstream-supported remedy?
rationale: The likely runtime correction is narrow, but changing the identity can invalidate existing pairings and force operator action, so the permanent default and upgrade behavior require explicit owner intent.

options.title: Desktop identity with guided re-pair
options.body: Use a Baileys Desktop identity for new pairings and surface a clear doctor/status recovery path for existing sessions that must be re-paired.

options.title: Retain identity and investigate upstream
options.body: Keep the existing identity temporarily while establishing another Baileys-supported mechanism that restores durable group push without invalidating pairings.

options.title: Add an identity setting
options.body: Expose the browser identity as configuration, accepting an additional compatibility-sensitive setting and multiple supported runtime modes.

recommendation.title: Desktop identity with guided re-pair
recommendation.body: Use a Baileys Desktop identity for new pairings and surface a clear doctor/status recovery path for existing sessions that must be re-paired.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the prior WhatsApp group-inbound reconnect repair in the same session lifecycle.
